visualize_matrix_heatmap: create a MatrixVisualizer to overlay a color-mapped matrix heatmap onto a BGR image within a bounding box
draw_rectangle_bbox: build a RectangleVisualizer to draw a colored bounding box rectangle on a BGR image
annotate_points_on_image: create a PointsVisualizer to draw colored circles at specified coordinate points on a BGR image
render_text_on_image: build a TextVisualizer to render text with configurable font, color, and transparency on a BGR image
compose_multiple_visualizers: create a CompoundVisualizer to chain multiple visualizers and apply them sequentially to a single BGR image
